subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on October 15, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XY123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Arrival Time: 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airline Team
